segments.title: Post-Disney Return & Venezuelan Deportation Crisis
segments.notes: Case Blackwell returns from Disney World, recounts Fantasmic show; Dwayne the Shamrock of Johnson delivers St. Patrick's Day commentary; Chet Manscape appears as 'Big Cheddar'; Kendall walks through studio; coverage of Trump administration defying court order on Venezuelan deportations and deportation of Dr. Rasha Allawi; beef tallow discussion.

segments.title: Internet Video Review: Epstein Musical, Eye-Hole Man, Pelican, Cannon Man, Pipe Rock Conspiracy
segments.notes: Case and Crum watch viewer-submitted videos: Joel Haver's Epstein musical, news cat, man with large eye socket, pelican eating capybara, human cannonball, Tim Lampier's pipe rock conspiracy video featuring Tom Cruise and Scientology.

segments.title: Leonor Braffinsman Speed Run: Chewing Wood, Jason Isaacs, Starship Troopers, Octopus Venom, Tiger Woods, Penis Crucifix, Funeral Home Justice
segments.notes: Case adopts 'Leonor Braffinsman' persona for rapid-fire news: study on chewing wood boosting brain antioxidants; Jason Isaacs on prosthetic penis double standard; Neil Blomkamp directing Starship Troopers; male octopus poisoning females; Tiger Woods dating Vanessa Trump; Behemoth acquitted for penis crucifix; funeral home worker stuffing penis in mouth; Grimes AI art.

segments.title: Ghost Jeb's Watermelon, Milk, Irish Coffee, Jelqing, Hot Dog, and Fishing Tutorials
segments.notes: Jeb Nogget broadcasts from 'the wood' as a ghost; demonstrates watermelon net chop, slicing milk, Irish coffee, jelqing with dildo, Vietnamese dessert, grilled hot dogs with cheese/chili, and hammer-bait fishing catching a mysterious object; Jeb's Dad (board) interjects.

segments.title: 1958 Yogi Bear Interview & Guy Redacted Returns
segments.notes: Case interviews 1958 Yogi Bear who confesses to killing Boo Boo, luring Boy Scouts, and starting Smoky Bear's parents' fire; Guy Redacted returns from silencing, investigates Avril Lavigne body double conspiracy, claims government changed search to 'body pool'.

segments.title: Solo Leveling vs. Hunter x Hunter Debate; Gorilla Debt Payment
segments.notes: Crum argues for unseen Solo Leveling (infinite theoretical quality); Munch defends Hunter x Hunter (ant soldier Frieza, Buddha technique). Munch wins vote; Rock-afire gorilla receives $5,000 auto-payment on Crum's $165,000 debt; gorilla's fence breaches causing dog infestation discussed.

segments.title: Sign-Off & Raid to Psychor
segments.notes: Munch delivers freestyle rap; Case raids Psychor's special event channel.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell returned from Disney World to anchor a broadcast dominated by the Trump administration's defiance of a federal court order on Venezuelan deportations and the removal of a Lebanese doctor. The episode cycled through Amongst the Web video reviews, a Leonor Braffinsman news speed run, a ghostly How To with Jeb, a surreal 1958 Yogi Bear confession interview, Guy Redacted's conspiracy return, and a Munch & Crum debate on anime that resulted in another $5,000 payment toward Crum's $165,000 debt to the Rock-afire gorilla — whose escalating fence breaches are now ruining Crum's yard with neighborhood dogs.
